description: DRC & Uganda - Ebola Outbreak - 2026 - OpenStreetMap Data is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). This dataset contains OpenStreetMap data exported from the HOTOSM disaster mapping response to the Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda started in May 2026 - Glide number: EP-2026-000071-COD. In May 2026, an epidemic of Ebola disease was reported in the Ituri Province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Coverage: Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda. The portal files it under the publisher Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Its tags are crisis-ebola-bundibugyo-virus-disease, facilities-infrastructure, geodata, natural disasters, populated places-settlements. It offers 8 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
